subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having '3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b94ce1271e2b28aee1cc94a375dfbb5fe36cc0b87dbfb4d835d5f91a50d844aa.png]
solution:
**__Explanation:__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e49f1b3e8801820ff7fd7083447ea4b2b86e446273423f8755725e5e3d372e88.png] 

4 and 2 are the common faces in 2nd and 3rd dice, so it is clear that 6 is opposite to 3.

Hence, '**6**' is the correct answer.
